title: Project Glass: One day...
summary: Google's early concept video for Project Glass, showing a wearer navigating a city with augmented-reality glasses that surface contextual information. It was made when the project was just starting.
why: HN refers to it as the aspirational Glass vision, often contrasted with what the product actually delivered.

quote.text: The original Glass demo video showed the wearer just looking at the sky in order to have weather information delivered
